purpose: Rejection record for precomputed per-position K/V slice headers in decode attention

baseline.description: Merged oct attend scoring and value-pass unroll

experiment.description: Precompute k/v slice headers per position into lane-scoped [][]float32 scratch so attend's kv() closure indexes a table instead of calling KVCache.row (div/mod + slice) twice per position.
experiment.isolated_kernel_result: flat-kv variant of the oct-score attend measured ~0.89-0.95x of the closure-based variant at hd64/128, lengths 33-2048
experiment.whole_generation_result: Historical observation: ~0.99-1.01x across five shapes x two processes, with completion equality checked by the local harness. Candidate integration was reverted and is not included in this PR. These results do not independently establish that header-fill cost explains the neutral timing.
experiment.reason: Neutral to slightly slower end-to-end, plus added workspace memory (lanes x stride x 2 headers) and clearing/lifecycle complexity. Experiment retained in cmd/monolith/attention_outputs_test.go (TestFlatKVAttendTiming) and validation/performance/flatkv-generation-20261108-run{1,2}.json

review_audit.status: Not adopted; historical observations retained, not a reproducible production benchmark in this PR.
review_audit.kernel_limitations: Precomputed header construction is outside the timed region; reference is timed first; ratios use independent minima. The isolated result is not an end-to-end speedup estimate.

local_provenance.availability: Sources remain local ignored artifacts; public timing arrays alone cannot reproduce the reverted integration or independently verify completions.

review_audit.interpretation: Retain the decision not to adopt a more complex implementation without demonstrated end-to-end benefit; do not infer header-fill causality or a general KV-layout ceiling.
